notes.title: Going Astray Update 1.1
notes.notes:
http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30720268/7617ba8b8c525817308ee42b08fdf644b3de957f.png

Thank you to all supporters of Going Astray here is a small notice to where we are at in the game development.

Update notes:
 A new song named Spiral has been added to the music list. We hope everyone is enjoying the various songs to choose from.
 The Bypass Orb, when picked up now, displays a timer for how long the pick-up will be in effect. 


Changes
- Now when choosing the controller in the settings it will cause the controller button controls to be displayed instead of the keyboard controls at the start of the game. 


Fixes
- A bug where you were able to turn multiple times has been removed. This bug could cause players to go in reverse.
